description: Machine-local corpus queries for the 61 workspaces indexed from this machine's outputs tree: cross-book topical discovery and within-book chapter finding. Every expected anchor was verified against the real chapter text before being recorded -- a case whose query terms do not occur in the expected document is an authoring error, not a retrieval weakness. Thresholds are regression floors set just below the measured baseline, not targets. This fixture is machine-local; the upstream global-knowledge-base branch keeps its own smaller corpus file.
known_gaps: chapter-09: the query spans a quotation mark inside the target chapter title (所谓“世界系”这个词), so the trigram index cannot match across it and the chapter lands at rank 6. Search normalization is punctuation-preserving by contract (nfkc+t2s); making the index punctuation-insensitive is a separate design change.

chapter-16 is the apparatus-demotion regression detector: without the knowledge_base.apparatus.json weight, the index chapter (docx-0011-索-引, weight 0.25) takes rank 1 because an index repeats every concept term. Do not 'fix' this case by retargeting it at the index.
